## TemplateEngine.\_processMessageBlocks() method

Extracts and parses `<message>` blocks from a template string.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _processMessageBlocks(template: string): {
        [lang: string]: string;
    };
```

An object mapping language keys to their cleaned message content

## Remarks

This internal method identifies all `<message>` blocks and extracts their content organized by language. Blocks without a `lang` attribute are stored under `"default"`<!-- -->. Leading whitespace and surrounding newlines are trimmed.

\*\*Attributes:\*\* - `lang` (optional): Language key for the output map. Defaults to `"default"`<!-- -->.

## Example


```typescript
const template = `
  <message>Hello World</message>
  <message lang="id">Halo Dunia</message>
`;
const messages = TemplateEngine._processMessageBlocks(template);
// Result: { default: 'Hello World', id: 'Halo Dunia' }
```
